title: Fifth National Climate Assessment Midwest chapter
product_or_endpoint: Midwest climate, infrastructure, agriculture, and ecological context
use_limitations: State and regional synthesis; not local damage, outage, or health projections.

title: Fifth National Climate Assessment energy chapter
product_or_endpoint: Heat, cooling demand, and energy-system context
use_limitations: Supports mechanisms and direction; no local outage probability.

title: GLISA Summary of Climate Change in the Great Lakes Region
product_or_endpoint: Regional warming, hot days, precipitation, drought, and seasonality ranges
use_limitations: Ranges are regional synthesis envelopes and are not a single model/scenario mapping.

title: GLISA Climate Trends in the Great Lakes Region
product_or_endpoint: Regional climate trend and projection factsheet
use_limitations: Use rounded ranges with source period; do not relabel late-century as a 2075 point estimate.

title: LOCA version 2 for North America
product_or_endpoint: Daily 6 km Tmin/Tmax/precipitation CMIP6 downscaled product
use_limitations: Product metadata supports explicit 2050/2075 windows; it is not a Lake Erie hydrodynamic or impact model.

title: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6
product_or_endpoint: Bias-corrected daily global downscaled CMIP6 context
use_limitations: Secondary screening context; archive/model availability must be checked before numeric use.

title: NOAA Ohio State Climate Summary
product_or_endpoint: State-level warming, precipitation, flooding, and drought direction
use_limitations: State direction is not a western-basin local quantitative projection.

title: NOAA Michigan State Climate Summary
product_or_endpoint: State-level warming, precipitation, Great Lakes, and drought direction
use_limitations: State direction is not a western-basin shoreline quantitative projection.

title: EPA Great Lakes climate indicators
product_or_endpoint: Observed Great Lakes levels/temperature and future variability context
use_limitations: Models disagree on overall level sign; do not impose a single trend.

title: Dynamical Downscaling-Based Projections of Great Lakes Water Levels
product_or_endpoint: Opposing MIROC5/CNRM lake-level branches under RCP8.5
use_limitations: Cross-lake ranges are not western Lake Erie shoreline positions or probabilities.

title: Dynamically Downscaled Projections of Lake-Effect Snow
product_or_endpoint: Lake-effect snow, ice, rain/snow transition, and seasonality
use_limitations: Older RCP8.5 model study; no exact future snowstorm or freeze-thaw count.

title: Projected precipitation changes within the Great Lakes and Western Lake Erie Basin
product_or_endpoint: Western Lake Erie precipitation ensemble context
spatial_scope: Great Lakes and Western Lake Erie Basin
use_limitations: Mixed CMIP5/CMIP3/RCM ensembles; no direct 2075 result or probability.

title: Western Lake Erie agricultural and meteorological HAB study
use_limitations: Supports mechanism, not future bloom magnitude, toxin, illness, or treatment burden.
